body: Dawn PvP is a lightweight, clean PvP-focused modpack designed for smooth performance and clear gameplay. It removes unnecessary clutter and focuses on stable, tested mods that improve FPS, UI readability, and overall PvP experience. Built for competitive players who want a simple, reliable setup without broken or conflicting mods Server rules vary, so please check what mods are allowed before playing on servers.
